summary: Phase 4 (Journey Playback) fully verified. 9/9 backend pytest tests pass covering endpoint shape, seed idempotency, tenant isolation, and trip grouping (>3 min gap = new trip, <3 min = same trip, all-zero-speed dropped). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: only 2 tracked cars (Ford Focus + Hyundai i30) show the Journey button on Fleet Board (data-testid=fleet-journey-<car_id>). Modal opens, date picker loads yesterday's 4 seeded trips, trip 0 auto-plays (PLAYING pill appears), map polylines render with start/end markers and animated car icon rotating with direction. All required data-testids exist: journey-playback-modal, journey-date-picker, journey-refresh, journey-close, journey-map, journey-controls, journey-point-info, journey-trip-list, journey-trip-0, journey-trip-0-playing, journey-play-toggle, journey-skip-back, journey-skip-forward, journey-scrubber, journey-speed-1x/2x/4x/8x, journey-seed-demo. Seed button appears when a date has 0 trips. No leaflet _leaflet_pos or unmount errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 12,383 lines — monolithic (noted as known blocker; not part of this task). Recommend splitting into feature routers.
gps_history_service.py returns tuple (points, wp_ix) from _build_demo_trip_points but the outer function ignores wp_ix in favor of updating it — actually it does capture it. Reviewed OK.
JourneyPlayback.js: date picker uses browser-native <input type="date">, per team preference this may be OK but not the shadcn calendar — flag only.
Scrubber uses React controlled range input; automated tests cannot reliably script drag events via JS due to React's native value setter override — real user drag works fine.
